class.name: OcgTransferProcessfortransient
class.brief_description: Manages Transfer of Transient Objects. Produces also ActorOfTransientProcess (deferred class), IteratorOfTransientProcess (for Results), TransferMapOfTransientProcess (internally used) Normally uses as TransientProcess, which adds some specifics
class.description: ! Manages Transfer of Transient Objects. Produces also ! ActorOfTransientProcess (deferred class), ! IteratorOfTransientProcess (for Results), ! TransferMapOfTransientProcess (internally used) ! Normally uses as TransientProcess, which adds some specifics

method.name: from_1
method.description: Sets TransferProcess at initial state. Gives an Initial size (indicative) for the Map when known (default is 10000). Sets default trace file as a printer and default trace level (see Message_TraceFile).

method.name: from_2
method.description: Sets TransferProcess at initial state. Gives an Initial size (indicative) for the Map when known (default is 10000). Sets a specified printer.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Resets a TransferProcess as ready for a completely new work. Clears general data (roots) and the Map

method.name: Clean
method.description: Rebuilds the Map and the roots to really remove Unbound items Because Unbind keeps the entity in place, even if not bound Hence, working by checking new items is meaningless if a formerly unbound item is rebound

method.name: Resize
method.description: Resizes the Map as required (if a new reliable value has been determined). Acts only if <nb> is greater than actual NbMapped

method.name: SetActor
method.description: Defines an Actor, which is used for automatic Transfer If already defined, the new Actor is cumulated (see SetNext from Actor)

method.name: Actor
method.description: Returns the defined Actor. Returns a Null Handle if not set.

method.name: Find
method.description: Returns the Binder which is linked with a starting Object It can either bring a Result (Transfer done) or none (for a pre-binding). If no Binder is linked with <start>, returns a Null Handle Considers a category number, by default 0

method.name: IsBound
method.description: Returns True if a Result (whatever its form) is Bound with a starting Object. I.e., if a Binder with a Result set, is linked with it Considers a category number, by default 0

method.name: IsAlreadyUsed
method.description: Returns True if the result of the transfer of an object is already used in other ones. If it is, Rebind cannot change it. Considers a category number, by default 0

method.name: Bind
method.description: Creates a Link a starting Object with a Binder. This Binder can either bring a Result (effective Binding) or none (it can be set later : pre-binding). Considers a category number, by default 0

method.name: Rebind
method.description: Changes the Binder linked with a starting Object for its unitary transfer. This it can be useful when the exact form of the result is known once the transfer is widely engaged. This can be done only on first transfer. Considers a category number, by default 0

method.name: Unbind
method.description: Removes the Binder linked with a starting object If this Binder brings a non-empty Check, it is replaced by a VoidBinder. Also removes from the list of Roots as required. Returns True if done, False if <start> was not bound Considers a category number, by default 0

method.name: FindElseBind
method.description: Returns a Binder for a starting entity, as follows : Tries to Find the already bound one If none found, creates a VoidBinder and Binds it

method.name: SetMessenger
method.description: Sets Messenger used for outputting messages.

method.name: Messenger
method.description: Returns Messenger used for outputting messages. The returned object is guaranteed to be non-null; default is Message::Messenger().

method.name: SetTraceLevel
method.description: Sets trace level used for outputting messages: <trace> = 0 : no trace at all <trace> = 1 : handled exceptions and calls to AddError <trace> = 2 : also calls to AddWarning <trace> = 3 : also traces new Roots (uses method ErrorTrace). Default is 1 : Errors traced

method.name: TraceLevel
method.description: Returns trace level used for outputting messages.

method.name: SendFail
method.description: New name for AddFail (Msg)

method.name: SendWarning
method.description: New name for AddWarning (Msg)

method.name: SendMsg
method.description: Adds an information message Trace is filled if trace level is at least 3

method.name: AddFail_2
method.description: Adds an Error message to a starting entity (to the check of its Binder of category 0, as a Fail)

method.name: AddError
method.description: (other name of AddFail, maintained for compatibility)

method.name: AddFail_1
method.description: Adds an Error Message to a starting entity from the definition of a Msg (Original+Value)

method.name: AddWarning_2
method.description: Adds a Warning message to a starting entity (to the check of its Binder of category 0)

method.name: AddWarning_1
method.description: Adds a Warning Message to a starting entity from the definition of a Msg (Original+Value)

method.name: Check
method.description: Returns the Check attached to a starting entity. If <start> is unknown, returns an empty Check Adds a case name to a starting entity Adds a case value to a starting entity Returns the complete case list for an entity. Null Handle if empty In the list of mapped items (between 1 and NbMapped), searches for the first item which follows <num0>(not included) and which has an attribute named <name> Attributes are brought by Binders Hence, allows such an iteration

method.name: BindTransient
method.description: Binds a starting object with a Transient Result. Uses a SimpleBinderOfTransient to work. If there is already one but with no Result set, sets its Result. Considers a category number, by default 0

method.name: FindTransient
method.description: Returns the Result of the Transfer of an object <start> as a Transient Result. Returns a Null Handle if there is no Transient Result Considers a category number, by default 0 Warning : Supposes that Binding is done with a SimpleBinderOfTransient

method.name: BindMultiple
method.description: Prepares an object <start> to be bound with several results. If no Binder is yet attached to <obj>, a MultipleBinder is created, empty. If a Binder is already set, it must accept Multiple Binding. Considers a category number, by default 0

method.name: AddMultiple
method.description: Adds an item to a list of results bound to a starting object. Considers a category number, by default 0, for all results

method.name: FindTypedTransient
method.description: Searches for a transient result attached to a starting object, according to its type, by criterium IsKind(atype)

method.name: GetTypedTransient
method.description: Searches for a transient result recorded in a Binder, whatever this Binder is recorded or not in <me>

method.name: NbMapped
method.description: Returns the maximum possible value for Map Index (no result can be bound with a value greater than it)

method.name: Mapped
method.description: Returns the Starting Object bound to an Index,

method.name: MapIndex
method.description: Returns the Index value bound to a Starting Object, 0 if none

method.name: MapItem
method.description: Returns the Binder bound to an Index Considers a category number, by default 0

method.name: SetRoot
method.description: Declares <obj> (and its Result) as Root. This status will be later exploited by RootResult, see below (Result can be produced at any time)

method.name: SetRootManagement
method.description: Enable (if <stat> True) or Disables (if <stat> False) Root Management. If it is set, Transfers are considered as stacked (a first Transfer commands other Transfers, and so on) and the Transfers commanded by an external caller are "Root". Remark : SetRoot can be called whatever this status, on every object. Default is set to True.

method.name: NbRoots
method.description: Returns the count of recorded Roots

method.name: Root
method.description: Returns a Root Entity given its number in the list (1-NbRoots)

method.name: RootItem
method.description: Returns the Binder bound with a Root Entity given its number Considers a category number, by default 0

method.name: RootIndex
method.description: Returns the index in the list of roots for a starting item, or 0 if it is not recorded as a root

method.name: NestingLevel
method.description: Returns Nesting Level of Transfers (managed by methods TranscriptWith & Co). Starts to zero. If no automatic Transfer is used, it remains to zero. Zero means Root Level.

method.name: ResetNestingLevel
method.description: Resets Nesting Level of Transfers to Zero (Root Level), whatever its current value.

method.name: Recognize
method.description: Tells if <start> has been recognized as good candidate for Transfer. i.e. queries the Actor and its Nexts

method.name: Transferring
method.description: Performs the Transfer of a Starting Object, by calling the method TransferProduct (see below). Mapping and Roots are managed : nothing is done if a Result is already Bound, an exception is raised in case of error.

method.name: Transfer
method.description: Same as Transferring but does not return the Binder. Simply returns True in case of success (for user call)

method.name: SetErrorHandle
method.description: Allows controls if exceptions will be handled Transfer Operations <err> False : they are not handled with try {} catch {} <err> True : they are Default is False: no handling performed

method.name: ErrorHandle
method.description: Returns error handling flag

method.name: StartTrace
method.description: Method called when trace is asked Calls PrintTrace to display information relevant for starting objects (which can be redefined) <level> is Nesting Level of Transfer (0 = root) <mode> controls the way the trace is done : 0 neutral, 1 for Error, 2 for Warning message, 3 for new Root

method.name: PrintTrace
method.description: Prints a short information on a starting object. By default prints its Dynamic Type. Can be redefined

method.name: IsLooping
method.description: Returns True if we are surely in a DeadLoop. Evaluation is not exact, it is a "majorant" which must be computed fast. This "majorant" is : <alevel> greater than NbMapped.

method.name: RootResult
method.description: Returns, as an iterator, the log of root transfer, i.e. the created objects and Binders bound to starting roots If withstart is given True, Starting Objects are also returned

method.name: CompleteResult
method.description: Returns, as an Iterator, the entire log of transfer (list of created objects and Binders which can bring errors) If withstart is given True, Starting Objects are also returned

method.name: AbnormalResult
method.description: Returns Binders which are neither "Done" nor "Initial", that is Error,Loop or Run (abnormal states at end of Transfer) Starting Objects are given in correspondence in the iterator

method.name: CheckList
method.description: Returns a CheckList as a list of Check : each one is for a starting entity which have either check (warning or fail) messages are attached, or are in abnormal state : that case gives a specific message If <erronly> is True, checks with Warnings only are ignored

method.name: ResultOne
method.description: Returns, as an Iterator, the log of transfer for one object <level> = 0 : this object only and if <start> is a scope owner (else, <level> is ignored) : <level> = 1 : object plus its immediate scoped ones <level> = 2 : object plus all its scoped ones

method.name: CheckListOne
method.description: Returns a CheckList for one starting object <level> interpreted as by ResultOne If <erronly> is True, checks with Warnings only are ignored

method.name: IsCheckListEmpty
method.description: Returns True if no check message is attached to a starting object. <level> interpreted as by ResultOne If <erronly> is True, checks with Warnings only are ignored

method.name: RemoveResult
method.description: Removes Results attached to (== Unbinds) a given object and, according <level> : <level> = 0 : only it <level> = 1 : it plus its immediately owned sub-results(scope) <level> = 2 : it plus all its owned sub-results(scope)

method.name: CheckNum
method.description: Computes a number to be associated to a starting object in a check or a check-list By default, returns 0; can be redefined
